inputs: 5-minute OHLC-derived B features from Alpaca IEX 5-minute bars fetched for the same permitted dates

target.future_price: close of candle timestamped exactly 10 minutes after the decision candle timestamp
target.eligible_binary_training: UP and DOWN events only; NO_SIGNAL excluded

features.one_minute: feature_schema.json; causal trailing OHLC/volume and session-time inputs with at most a 10-minute rolling lookback, reset at each session and missing-minute gap
features.five_minute: the frozen 24 B features in their original order, using live_app.features.calculate_b_features on direct Alpaca IEX 5-minute bars from identical train/validation dates
features.volume: only trailing one-minute volume features in the one-minute candidate; never added to the existing 5-minute B feature set

preprocessing: median imputation fitted inside each fold; StandardScaler additionally fitted inside Logistic Regression fold pipelines

walk_forward.method: expanding chronological by training trading date
walk_forward.purge: exclude training rows whose target endpoint is at or beyond the evaluation fold start

selective_policy.selection: Among OOF candidates meeting >=20% eligible coverage and emission guards, maximize mean fold macro directional precision; tie-break by mean emitted eligible accuracy, macro F1, then log loss. No validation metric selects a model or threshold.

validation: one final confirmation of the single training-OOF selected interval/model/threshold; validation is previously used and not pristine
